title: The Commission's Gazette notices on the Register of Political Parties, read from the Gazette lane's export of every notice (else the parties lane's own export)

landmarks: a JSON line of the Gazette lane's export whose notice number is in section au and whose title is the register's: (political|registered) part, party logo(s), registration of party, register of political
or a line of the parties lane's export of 19 October 2026 (keys notice, published_on, title, url, old_type, text)

signals_note: Not documents the Commission published: exports of the article text the old estate captured. 137 notices: the parties export's 136, each word for word the Gazette lane's copy after the reader's normalising, and 2023-au2700 (Heartland New Zealand's cancellation, typed by the old classifier as an authority's). Every row is 'taken from the old estate's tables; original not held'.
notes: Each notice holds one or more resolutions, each opening 'Pursuant to', 'On <date>,' or 'At its meeting on'. The text is flattened and glued at block boundaries ('Kiwi Partyat the party's request', 'Internet PartyThe Internet Party logo'), so a name ends at the first delimiter, glue included. Kinds: registered, cancelled, renamed (stated: 'change the party name of X to Y', 'by X to change its party name to Y', 'New Party Name: Y … Previous Party Name: X'), abbreviation, logo, components, corrected (a corrigendum names the notice and the text it replaces). The day decided is the first date of the resolution; the 2008 year's list states none. A deterministic read: no model.
applies_to: pub.gazette_notices rows in section au with a register title, text from the Gazette lane's export (sha256 47de7e09…); the parties export (dc19fb7f…) where the Gazette lane holds no copy or a different text.
process: Signatures ('Dated at Wellington …', 'ROBERT PEDEN, Chief Electoral Officer') are removed first.
A rename keeps the registration; a cancelled party registered again is a new registration.
A logo cancelled under section 70A ('cancel the registration of the X Party logo') is a logo resolution, not the party's cancellation; 'X and its logo' is the party's.
gates: Every notice gives an event or a catch-log line.
A resolution the reader sees and cannot read is a catch-log line, never a guess.
on_fail: set aside the resolution; publish the rest
